info.bio:
George McCrae nacido el 19 de octubre de 1944, Florida. En 1967 reformó el grupo “Jivin' Jets” acompañado de su esposa, Gwen McCrae, pero posteriormente decidieron trabajar como un dúo grabando para el estudio americano Henry Stone.

“KC and the Sunshine Band” invitaron a McCrae a cantar la canción “Rock Your Baby”, debido a que la canción requería de altas notas musicales y El lo logró satisfactoriamente consiguiendo fugazmente la fama por esta canción.

podcast.title: Background Vocalist for Wife
podcast.body: He contributed background vocals on his wife Gwen McCrae's answer record, "Rockin' Chair." "Her husband ends up singing background vocals on it."

podcast.title: Serendipitous Career Break
podcast.body: George McCrae's involvement in "Rock Your Baby" came at a fortuitous time, as he had stopped singing to manage his wife Gwen's music career. "It was kind of a right place at the right time situation for George McCray who had stopped singing because he became the manager and was managing the career of his wife Gwen."
